Model XWS-2610 is also mentioned in the FCC documents.
A C2PC request on 11/30/2018 mentions, "Changing the manufacture of IC Chip to TSMC (Part number: BCM4366EKMMLW1G) from UMC (Part number: BCM4366EKMMLWG)."
"8WAPAC37.1A1G" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC internal photos from the C2PC request on 11/30/2018. These photos also show the BCM4366EKMMLW1G radios with a TE1808 date code.
